title: Best cookware ever!! Love it!!!
text: Best cookware ever!! Love it!!!. Received this set about a week and a half ago. This is the most amazing and durable set I have ever owned. I have used every one of the pots and pans (with the exception of the smallest). I will say that the one thing I really enjoy is the feel and gripping of the handles and the way the lids are custom fit with grippings which emulate the handles on the pots. Considering I am not the best chef in the world (although I am desperately trying to be, lol), I sometimes overccok items. I found nothing to stick to the inside of the pots and after I have washed them each at least half a dozen (or more) times, the set looks and feels brand new. If I had one complaint, at all, is that I would have liked the largest pot (8 quart) to be wider (all pots have a tendency to be taller, but not wide). When I cooked lasagna, I would have appreciated the pot to be wider to make it easier to stir and separate the noodles. But outside of that, I absolutely love the Circulon brand and highly recommend them to anyone (especially for a shower or wedding gift). I will be buying this set for my daughter in law for Christmas (I think this would make a spectacular gift).

product_metadata.title: Circulon 82687 Espree Hard Anodized Nonstick Deep Frying Pan / Fry Pan / Skillet with Lid and Helper Handle - 12 Inch, Black
features: The 12-inch skillet’s hard-anodized construction provides quick, even heat distribution for top-quality cooking results
PFOA-free TOTAL Food Release System with premium nonstick on raised circles offers easy food release without added oil
Shatter-resistant glass lid seals in heat and moisture; comfortable, rubberized stainless steel handle is dual riveted with fold-out ring
Oven safe to 400 degrees Fahrenheit, the skillet is metal utensil safe
description: Start and end the day with delicious entrées and side dishes prepared in the stylish Circulon Espree Hard-Anodized Nonstick 12-Inch Covered Deep Skillet. This skillet’s heavy-duty hard-anodized construction provides quick and even heat distribution for faster cooking results. With the TOTAL(r) Food Release System of raised circles and the long-lasting, PFOA-free premium-quality nonstick that coats them, it’s easy to make an egg white and honey turkey scramble, sauté root vegetables or sear salmon filets without the need for added oils or fats. In addition, this superior nonstick technology offers exceptional food release and is safe for use with metal utensils. A shatter-resistant glass lid allows cooking to be monitored without losing heat or moisture. The nonstick pan’s comfortable, rubberized stainless steel handle is dual riveted for added strength and features a fold-out ring so the pan hangs for convenient storage. Oven safe to 400°F, this covered deep skillet is an ideal complement to specialty pots and other pans in the Circulon Espree collection. Just the right size to help create delicious foods for any meal, Circulon Espree Hard-Anodized Nonstick 12-Inch Covered Deep Skillet adds style to the stovetop day and night.
